Guideline: Install via shadcn CLI or MCP
Description: MagicUI components are copy-to-project via shadcn registry
Do: npx shadcn@latest add <component-name> or use MagicUI MCP
Don't: npm install magicui (no such package exists)

Guideline: Use MagicUI MCP for AI IDE integration
Description: Install MagicUI MCP server for natural language component installation
Do: npx @magicuidesign/cli@latest install cursor
Don't: Manual copy-paste from docs

Guideline: Ensure framer-motion dependency
Description: Most MagicUI components require framer-motion
Do: npm install framer-motion before using animated components
Don't: Use without framer-motion

Guideline: Use BlurFade for entrance animations
Description: BlurFade is the recommended default entrance effect for most content
Do: BlurFade for section content cards and images
Don't: Custom fade animations from scratch

Guideline: Use TextAnimate for hero headlines
Description: TextAnimate supports word-by-word and character-by-character entrance
Do: TextAnimate with stagger for hero headlines
Don't: Static headings on premium landing pages

Guideline: Use WordRotate for dynamic positioning statements
Description: Cycle through multiple concept words in a single headline slot
Do: WordRotate for multi-audience product positioning
Don't: Static single-value headlines

Guideline: Use MorphingText for AI/transformation products
Description: MorphingText particle-morphs between words conveying transformation
Do: MorphingText for AI capability showcase loops
Don't: MorphingText for static content pages

Guideline: Use NumberTicker for metrics
Description: NumberTicker animates numbers from 0 to target value on viewport entry
Do: NumberTicker for social proof stats and dashboard metrics
Don't: Static numbers for achievements

Guideline: Use TextReveal for scroll-driven storytelling
Description: TextReveal unlocks words progressively as user scrolls
Do: TextReveal for brand manifesto and about pages
Don't: TextReveal for short above-fold content

Guideline: Use Globe for global reach narrative
Description: Globe renders a WebGL 3D earth with animated connection arcs
Do: Globe in hero for global platform products
Don't: Globe for local or non-global products

Guideline: Provide Globe mobile fallback
Description: Globe is GPU-intensive and may underperform on mobile
Do: Check devicePixelRatio and reduce globe size or use static on mobile
Don't: Globe at full size on all devices

Guideline: Use OrbitingCircles for relationship visualization
Description: OrbitingCircles shows items orbiting a center point conveying ecosystem
Do: OrbitingCircles for tech stack or integration showcases
Don't: OrbitingCircles for unrelated items

Guideline: Use AnimatedBeam for connection narratives
Description: AnimatedBeam draws animated lines between elements
Do: AnimatedBeam for AI agent flow or data pipeline diagrams
Don't: AnimatedBeam for decorative purposes without semantic meaning

Guideline: Use BentoGrid for feature showcases
Description: BentoGrid provides a visually rich asymmetric feature grid
Do: BentoGrid for SaaS feature sections
Don't: BentoGrid for simple uniform card grids

Guideline: Customize BentoGrid deeply to avoid template look
Description: Default BentoGrid is recognizable; always customize colors and content
Do: Customize gradient colors icons and background of each card
Don't: Use default MagicUI BentoGrid without modification
Code Good: Custom gradients + unique icons per card

Guideline: Use GridPattern or DotPattern for subtle depth
Description: Background patterns add spatial depth without competing with content
Do: GridPattern with low opacity as section background
Don't: Solid flat color backgrounds for tech products

Guideline: Use FlickeringGrid for living tech aesthetics
Description: FlickeringGrid creates a subtle animated grid with random cell flicker
Do: FlickeringGrid for developer tools and data infrastructure products
Don't: FlickeringGrid for lifestyle or non-tech brands

Guideline: Use Particles for celebration and ambient atmosphere
Description: Particles creates floating particle effects for ambient atmosphere
Do: Particles for hero sections of AI and science products
Don't: Particles as primary visual element without content hierarchy

Guideline: Use MagicCard for interactive product cards
Description: MagicCard adds mouse-tracking gradient glow to card hover state
Do: MagicCard for premium feature cards and pricing tiers
Don't: MagicCard for all cards including simple list items

Guideline: Use BorderBeam for premium container highlight
Description: BorderBeam animates a glowing beam around a container border
Do: BorderBeam for primary CTA containers and premium feature cards
Don't: BorderBeam on multiple elements simultaneously

Guideline: Use Marquee for logo walls and testimonials
Description: Marquee creates infinite scroll carousels without JS complexity
Do: Marquee for partner logos and testimonial streams
Don't: Marquee for primary navigation or critical content

Guideline: Install via shadcn MCP with @react-bits registry
Description: ReactBits uses shadcn registry pattern with custom registry URL
Do: Add @react-bits to components.json registries then use shadcn MCP
Don't: Manual download of ReactBits source files

Guideline: Use Dither for editorial and AI aesthetics
Description: Dither creates noise-dithered bitmap-style backgrounds with high visual uniqueness
Do: Dither for AI tools and creative agency backgrounds
Don't: Dither for e-commerce or family products
Code Good: Add Dither from @react-bits registry with custom color
Code Bad: Use default Dither without color customization

Guideline: Use Aurora for AI and premium fluid aesthetics
Description: Aurora creates smooth flowing light aurora effects as background
Do: Aurora for AI products VR/AR tools and high-end brand pages
Don't: Aurora for productivity tools needing neutral focus environment
Code Good: Aurora background with brand color palette
Code Bad: Aurora with default colors without theme alignment

Guideline: Use FlowField for data and intelligence narratives
Description: FlowField renders a Perlin noise vector flow field as animated background
Do: FlowField for data analytics AI infrastructure and science products
Don't: FlowField for lifestyle consumer apps
Code Good: FlowField with subdued intensity and brand color vectors

Guideline: Use Background Studio for visual exploration
Description: Background Studio is a browser-based tool to preview and tune ReactBits backgrounds
Do: Use Background Studio to find right intensity and color before coding
Don't: Guess background parameters without previewing

Guideline: Use FadeContent for scroll-triggered reveals
Description: FadeContent adds fade+slide entrance when element enters viewport
Do: FadeContent wrapping all content sections for reveal
Don't: FadeContent for above-fold hero content already visible

Guideline: Use SplitText for dramatic title entrances
Description: SplitText animates each character individually for high-drama headlines
Do: SplitText for hero titles and key messaging
Don't: SplitText for body text or lists

Guideline: Use TextPressure for interactive tactile headlines
Description: TextPressure morphs font weight based on mouse proximity creating tactile feel
Do: TextPressure for interactive hero headings inviting engagement
Don't: TextPressure for body text or information-dense areas

Guideline: Install via shadcn CLI with animate-ui namespace
Description: AnimateUI follows shadcn copy-to-project pattern with animate-ui component names
Do: npx shadcn@latest add animate-ui/button for animated button
Don't: npm install animate-ui

Guideline: Enable shadcn MCP for natural language installation
Description: AnimateUI supports shadcn MCP for AI-assisted installation
Do: Configure shadcn MCP server then prompt AI to install animate-ui components
Don't: Manual registry browsing and copy

Guideline: Use AnimateUI Button for physical feel CTAs
Description: AnimateUI Button adds Framer Motion spring animation with hoverScale and tapScale
Do: AnimateUI Button for primary CTAs where tactile feedback matters
Don't: Regular shadcn Button is fine for utility actions

Guideline: Tune spring values for brand personality
Description: hoverScale and tapScale control the physical feel of the button
Do: Lower tapScale (0.92) for more dramatic press; higher hoverScale (1.08) for bold hover
Don't: Default spring values for all brand contexts
Code Bad: Same spring values for corporate and playful brands

Guideline: Use AnimateUI Dialog for smooth modal transitions
Description: AnimateUI Dialog adds spring-physics open/close animation to Radix Dialog
Do: AnimateUI Dialog for modals that feel native and smooth
Don't: AnimateUI Dialog for quick confirmation modals where speed matters more
Code Good: AnimateUI Dialog with appropriate duration for context

Guideline: Maintain Radix accessibility semantics
Description: AnimateUI wraps Radix components; all ARIA attributes are preserved
Do: Rely on inherited Radix a11y; test with screen reader
Don't: Override Radix ARIA without understanding impact

Guideline: Combine ReactBits backgrounds with MagicUI text animations
Description: Pair ReactBits generative backgrounds with MagicUI text effects for cohesive hero
Do: ReactBits Dither/Aurora + MagicUI BlurFade for text entrance
Don't: Mix multiple background libraries in one page
Code Good: Dither background + BlurFade headings + AnimateUI CTAs

Guideline: Use MagicUI Bento Grid with BlurFade cards
Description: BentoGrid layout with BlurFade animation on each card staggered by index
Do: BentoGrid + staggered BlurFade (delay={0.1 * index}) on cards
Don't: BentoGrid with no entrance animation

Guideline: Layer AnimateUI interactions over MagicUI layout
Description: MagicUI handles layout and visual components; AnimateUI handles interaction feel
Do: MagicUI cards + AnimateUI button CTAs inside each card
Don't: Use both libraries to style the same element differently
Code Bad: MagicCard button AND AnimateUI Button wrapping same element

Guideline: Avoid direct use of default Globe styling
Description: Globe with default purple/teal colors is widely recognized as MagicUI template
Do: Customize Globe colors to match brand palette
Don't: Use Globe with default colors and arcs
Code Good: Globe with custom colors + brand-colored arc paths
Code Bad: Default purple Globe with generic white arcs

Guideline: Avoid simultaneous Orbiting + Beam + Globe
Description: Combining all three MagicUI signature effects creates immediately recognizable template look
Do: Choose one signature MagicUI effect per page as hero centerpiece
Don't: Stack Globe + OrbitingCircles + AnimatedBeam in same section
Code Good: Globe as sole hero + OrbitingCircles in different section

Guideline: Limit particle count on mobile devices
Description: Particle effects are GPU-intensive; mobile devices need lower counts
Do: Detect mobile and reduce particle count or disable
Don't: Full desktop particle count on mobile

Guideline: Lazy load Globe and heavy WebGL components
Description: Globe requires WebGL and cobe library; lazy load to avoid blocking LCP
Do: React.lazy() for Globe component
Don't: Eager import Globe at top of file
Code Bad: import Globe from './Globe' in page component

Guideline: Respect prefers-reduced-motion
Description: All animated components must check prefers-reduced-motion
Do: Most MagicUI/ReactBits components have built-in support; verify custom combinations
Don't: Assume all users want animations
Code Good: Test with prefers-reduced-motion:reduce in browser DevTools
